description: This file defines the class SOAPClientEngine, which is a final class extending GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for invoking SOAP web services within the OFBiz framework. It handles setting up the ServiceClient, configuring the endpoint, serializing parameters, sending requests, and processing responses for SOAP-based service calls.

classes.name: SOAPClientEngine
classes.description: A final class that extends GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for managing SOAP service calls, including setup, parameter serialization, invocation, and response handling within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides the base method to invoke a SOAP service and ignore the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to invoke a SOAP service synchronously and return the result map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Private method that performs the actual SOAP service invocation, including setting up the client, preparing parameters, sending the request, and processing the response.
